svg.title: Infant feeding at the seats of 239 Bavarian districts, 1858 to 1861
svg.desc: Each point is a district seat, colored by how the district physician described infant feeding. Blue points, predominantly breastfed, fill Franconia and the Palatinate. Red and amber points, rarely or briefly breastfed, fill Swabia and parts of Lower Bavaria. Upper Bavaria is blank because its reports are not in this collection.
